name: Lazy Dragon 53
author: alexruix
description: Neon rounded red toggle switch that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: Clicking it toggles it: background-color changes from transparent to #f7b48e, box-shadow becomes 0 0 0 2px #f32f21, 0 0 4px #777, transform becomes translateX(1.5em). On focus, box-shadow becomes 0 0 0 2px #f32f21, 0 0 4px #777.
